title: Dropdown
description: Shows a menu of actions or options when its trigger is clicked. Near the viewport edges the menu flips and shifts to stay visible.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Without children a small default trigger button is rendered. onSelect receives the chosen item.

custom-trigger.title: Custom trigger
custom-trigger.description: Any element can be the trigger: a Button, an IconButton or plain text, which becomes keyboard focusable.

directions.title: Directions
directions.description: direction is the preferred side: below (default), above, left or right of the trigger. Near the viewport edges the menu flips to the opposite side and shifts into view.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disable individual items, or the whole dropdown.

custom-menu.title: Custom menu style
custom-menu.description: Customize the menu background, text color and shadow.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: open and onOpenChange control the menu from outside; defaultOpen sets the initial state when it is uncontrolled.

DropdownProps.onSelect: Called with the selected item; the menu closes afterwards
DropdownProps.direction: Preferred side on which the menu opens; it flips to the opposite side and shifts to stay inside the viewport
DropdownProps.children: Trigger element; a small "Dropdown" button is rendered when omitted
DropdownProps.open: Whether the menu is open (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)
DropdownProps.onOpenChange: Called when the menu requests to open or close

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.body: The trigger gets aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu and focuses the first enabled item; ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Home and End move between items, Enter or Space selects, and Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger. Set ariaLabel to name the menu.
